name: actions/magnetic-button
title: Magnetic button
description: A button that leans toward the pointer.

files.content:
export { MagneticButton } from './MagneticButton';
export type { MagneticButtonProps } from './MagneticButton';

keyboard.action: Move focus to and from the button. Focus never moves it.

notes: A native `<button>`; the pull is purely visual and never changes focus or the accessible name.
The pull is capped at 40% of the reach (at least 8 px), so the button never leaves its own footprint.
Movement is driven by the pointer only. Touch input is ignored, so a tap lands where it was aimed.
Spring updates write CSS variables directly, so no React render runs per frame.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The button does not move and the field ring does not appear. It behaves exactly like Button.
